title: Taylor Swift Open Mic + Swiftie Meet Up
description:
Our first ever Taylor Swift Open Mic + Swiftie Meet Up.

Calling all Swifties: for one night The Grey Lady belongs to Taylor. Bring a favourite song from any era and take your turn on the open mic, or just come along, sing along and meet other fans.

Thursday 29 October 2026, from 7pm
The Grey Lady, Tunbridge Wells
Tickets £2, book below.

Want to perform, or have a question? Email openmic.ts@gmail.com.

All Swifties welcome.
address: The Grey Lady, 70-72 The Pantiles, Royal Tunbridge Wells, TN2 5TW

title: Hardlines
description: A night of fantastic live music performed by Hardlines! These masters of jazz funk, Neil Robinson on guitar, Tim Cansfield on guitar, Bill Gibbard on bass, Gary Plumley or Frank Mead on sax, Iain Rae on keyboards. They are truly a great band composed of excellent musicians with a superb repertoire of covers, and even some originals from Iain himself.
address: The Grey Lady, 70-72 The Pantiles, Royal Tunbridge Wells, TN2 5TW

title: Funkenstein: Halloween Funk Night
description:
Get your glad rags (and your fangs) on: Funkenstein take over The Grey Lady for a Halloween night of funk and soul — great to listen to, even better to dance to.

With special guest Dave Ital on guitar, plus Roger Lewin (keyboards), Jerome Davis (bass), Gary Bucknor (drums), Lionel Shell (percussion) and Dan Foster (sax).

Fancy dress very welcome. Tickets £10, limited to 60.
address: The Grey Lady, 70-72 The Pantiles, Royal Tunbridge Wells, TN2 5TW

title: Open Mic: Singers Night
description:
How the Night Works

A welcoming evening for all vocalists, from beginners to pros! Sing with live piano accompaniment by Roger Lewin in a fun, supportive atmosphere. Bring sheet music, backing tracks, or your own original songs. Great vibes, great music, and great food – come sing or just enjoy the show!

Entry & Contact

Entry £5 for singers and listeners. Questions? Email singersnight@yahoo.com.
address: The Grey Lady, 70-72 The Pantiles, Royal Tunbridge Wells, TN2 5TW

title: DROVER: Blue & Gold EP Launch
description:
Join Tunbridge Wells folk duo D R O V E R for an intimate acoustic launch of their debut EP, Blue & Gold. Made up of theatre composer Stephen Hyde and Irish actor-musician Peter Long, D R O V E R draw on their Cumbrian and Corkonian roots to create evocative music shaped by close-harmony singing and poignant storytelling. Expect original folk songs, rearranged trad tunes, and the odd dark murder ballad, across two cosy, completely acoustic sets.

Doors 7pm, music from 7:30pm. Food and drink are served upstairs throughout the evening.
address: The Grey Lady, 70-72 The Pantiles, Royal Tunbridge Wells, TN2 5TW

title: The Grey Lady Sessions: Paul Dunton Orchestra + Primrose
description: The Grey Lady Sessions returns with the Paul Dunton Orchestra, plus support from Primrose. Doors open 7.15pm. Advance tickets only £12.50, with none available on the door.
address: The Grey Lady, 70-72 The Pantiles, Royal Tunbridge Wells, TN2 5TW

title: The Dujons
description: Where jazz meets pop and the blues. The two Johns in The Dujons originally sang together as choristers at Westminster Cathedral. Now John Harriman is well known as a super-talented keyboard player, while vocalist John Murray’s interpretation of songs brings out the richness of music from jazz classics to pop and the blues. Join them and a very talented band for what is sure to be a fun-filled evening.
address: The Grey Lady, 70-72 The Pantiles, Royal Tunbridge Wells, TN2 5TW

title: Fiesta Latina: Shine & Sparkle
description:
Fiesta Latina returns to The Grey Lady with Shine & Sparkle: YANIFIT and DJ Javi “La Máquina de Cuba” with salsa, merengue, cumbia, samba, reggaeton and more. A touch of sparkle is always fun, or just come ready to dance. Good music, Latin beats, a proper party.

Tickets

  • Full Experience — £35, 6.30pm: tapas, YANI FIT dance session and party with DJ Javi until late
  • Dance & Party — £25, 8.30pm: YANI FIT dance session and party with DJ Javi until late
  • Party Only — £12, 9.30pm

Dress code: silver, sparkle, glitter.

Presented by YANIFIT. Tickets and info: bookwhen.com/yanifit or call 07598816203.
address: The Grey Lady, 70-72 The Pantiles, Royal Tunbridge Wells, TN2 5TW
